metadata.warm_http: primed outside timing; document reload resets JS; no saved reading prefetch
metadata.timing: navigation performance.now(); interactions from just before action to functional DOM readiness; includes typing/debounce and automation round trips
metadata.next_frame: two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after readiness; not completion of animations
metadata.transfer: CDP loadingFinished encodedDataLength including response headers; cached/worker responses excluded from network_bytes
metadata.origin_body: server audit of response bodies only, excluding headers; includes worker-initiated downloads absent from page CDP
metadata.offline_transfer: use origin_body_bytes for offline_preparation; page CDP excludes worker network
metadata.memory: V8 page JSHeapUsedSize after requested GC, outside timing; not peak, RSS, DOM, GPU or worker heap
metadata.host_isolation: shared execution container; CPU frequency and competing host load uncontrolled
